notes.title: Lumines Remastered Patch 1.01 (07/11/18)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32966245/bc7931c6c3263fd9f987fcf61ccbe27f0897fd3a.png

Lumines Remastered Patch 1.01 (07/11/18)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------

Optimized load times (title screen, game modes and rankings)
Fixed issue with the last timeline column not adding to final score in Time Attack Mode
Improved audio mix in certain skins and expanded overall audio volume range from 4 level settings to 8 (default option for BGM and Sound Effects is 4)
Fixed issue with high score/ranking information not being displayed
Fixed issues seen in Display/Borderless Window option
Other minor performance improvements and bug fixes

Thanks for all the support since our launch!
